claim_boundary: ACCEPTED_BOUNDED_CAPABILITY only; active diagnostic input selection over an existing finite executable repository-patch version space, not general repository coding, open-ended test invention, effectful experimentation, unrestricted program synthesis, or AGI.
critical_unknowns: R2.59 improves evidence acquisition only after a useful candidate version space already exists; it does not repair missing target hypotheses or improve repository candidate generation itself.
Legal probe domains remain finite and host-provided; autonomous open-ended probe-domain construction is not established.
RepositoryProbe supports positional JSON-scalar inputs only; stateful, temporal, concurrent, filesystem, dependency and other effectful diagnostic experiments remain outside the representation.
The external NumPy transfer uses an independently sourced I/O oracle but a host-authored four-hypothesis candidate set, so hypothesis-generation independence is not established.

R2.59 reduces selection-label ambiguity but terminal safety still uses exhaustive verification: 2,401 labels per authored episode and 625 on the NumPy transfer, so total oracle-call efficiency is not demonstrated.
Independent candidate generators, counterfactual representation families, hostile/stateful oracles and broad fresh-repository issue-resolution evidence remain insufficient for W5 convergence.
